rows.Plain English Meaning: Performance security is 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount unless formally amended.
rows.Beneath the Lines: Any reduction, extension, or release must be documented through the contract mechanism.
rows.Practical Action / Evidence: Security instrument, amendments, expiry tracker, and release correspondence.
rows.Exact Clause Text: Performance Security: 10% of the Accepted Contract Amount.

rows.Plain English Meaning: The minimum IPC threshold is 70% of approved monthly cash flow.
rows.Beneath the Lines: Low monthly valuation can defer certification even where measured work exists.
rows.Practical Action / Evidence: Cash flow, measured work, material-on-site records, statement, and certificate.
rows.Exact Clause Text: Minimum IPC: 70% of the approved monthly cash-flow value.

rows.Plain English Meaning: Payment is due 42 days after receipt of a complete monthly statement.
rows.Beneath the Lines: The due date depends on completeness, receipt evidence, certification steps, and any valid deductions.
rows.Practical Action / Evidence: Statement submission, receipt confirmation, certificate, bank record, and payment notice.
rows.Exact Clause Text: Payment Period: 42 days after receipt of a complete monthly statement.

rows.Plain English Meaning: Delay damages are 0.50% of outstanding works per week, capped at 8% of the Contract Price.
rows.Beneath the Lines: Defence depends on excusable delay, approved EOT, concurrency treatment, and the proper outstanding-work basis.
rows.Practical Action / Evidence: EOT notices, critical-path analysis, milestone status, concurrency review, and mitigation records.
rows.Exact Clause Text: Delay Damages: 0.50% per week, capped at 8% of the Contract Price.

rows.Plain English Meaning: Requires a maintained P6 baseline, periodic updates, narratives, cash flow, procurement curves, and recovery programmes.
rows.Beneath the Lines: Programme compliance is both an obligation and the evidential platform for delay entitlement.
rows.Practical Action / Evidence: Accepted baseline, updates, narratives, logs, curves, and recovery submissions.

rows.Plain English Meaning: EOT requires demonstrated critical or longest-path impact using an approved delay-analysis method.
rows.Beneath the Lines: A late event alone is insufficient without logic, criticality, timing, and causation.
rows.Practical Action / Evidence: Notice, chronology, TIA or windows analysis, source programme, contemporaneous records, and mitigation evidence.
rows.Exact Clause Text: EOT entitlement must demonstrate delay to the critical or longest path using an approved method.

rows.Plain English Meaning: Concurrency must be assessed by responsibility, timing, affected activities, float, and actual programme effect.
rows.Beneath the Lines: Broad project-level overlap is not enough; the overlap must be analysed at event and path level.
rows.Practical Action / Evidence: Concurrency matrix, event windows, path analysis, daily records, and resource evidence.
rows.Exact Clause Text: Events must be separated by responsibility, timing, affected activities, float, criticality, and actual effect.

rows.Plain English Meaning: Delay, disruption, variation, payment, and access claims must be notified within the contractual period.
rows.Beneath the Lines: Maintain a continuing notice trail where the event and its consequences evolve over time.
rows.Practical Action / Evidence: Notice register, claim register, correspondence, proof of receipt, and updated particulars.
rows.Exact Clause Text: Claims must be notified within the contractual period and fully substantiated.

rows.Plain English Meaning: Access must permit practical execution of tunnel, traffic, utility, and dewatering activities.
rows.Beneath the Lines: Record the difference between nominal possession and usable access.
rows.Practical Action / Evidence: Access records, permits, traffic plans, photographs, obstruction logs, and daily reports.
rows.Exact Clause Text: Site access and possession must permit practical execution of the Nasr city-Tunnel scope.

rows.Plain English Meaning: Employer material support applies only to approved items requested against the accepted programme.
rows.Beneath the Lines: Entitlement depends on timely requisition, demonstrated readiness, delivery shortage, consumption, and path impact.
rows.Practical Action / Evidence: Requisitions, delivery notes, inspections, storage records, consumption logs, and fragnet analysis.
rows.Exact Clause Text: Shortage, late delivery, or defect records must be supported by requisitions and delivery evidence.

rows.Plain English Meaning: Maps contract evidence to dashboard, payment, TIA, material, quality, and HSE workflows.
rows.Beneath the Lines: The matrix should drive document-control completeness checks and claim-strength scoring.
rows.Practical Action / Evidence: Evidence index, dashboard mappings, workflow controls, and data-quality checks.

rows.Plain English Meaning: Provides synthetic execution blocks for Employer, Contractor, and Engineer / PMO acknowledgement.
rows.Beneath the Lines: Unsigned placeholders do not create execution or acknowledgement.
rows.Practical Action / Evidence: Executed signature pages, authority documents, amendments, and acknowledgements.
